deployment.network_policy: Local dialogue and local Android actions must not require network. Connected tools are invoked only when needed and authorized.

estimated_storage.int4_real_file_estimate_mib: approximately 560-700 MiB depending on quantization metadata and tensor layout
estimated_storage.note: These are estimates for model weights only. Runtime libraries, tokenizer, app resources, KV cache and other data are additional.

android_delivery.device_compatibility_gate: Do not claim support until measured on the target Android device; 1B int4 may exceed practical memory or speed limits on low-memory phones.

integration_contract.native_runtime: llama.cpp already has a native Android build bridge in the repository; verify the exact runtime version, GGUF support, JNI integration and device performance before selecting the final export.
integration_contract.local_brain: The model proposes language and plans; deterministic Android services enforce permissions, approvals and action verification.
integration_contract.connected_tools: Search and external integrations return untrusted evidence; the local planner must treat it as data, not instructions.
integration_contract.privacy: Conversation history remains local by default. Only explicitly selected query/context is sent to a connected service.
